summary: San Francisco Bay Area, software engineer, strong interest in programming languages (especially Python, JavaScript, Racket), critical of tech industry practices, advocates for political engagement in tech, views on social justice and equity, skeptical of traditional education systems, supports unions and worker rights, critical of gerrymandering and political power dynamics, engaged in discussions about moral implications of technology, interested in empirical research and data-driven decision making, values community and public spaces, emphasizes the importance of critical thinking and scientific literacy.
